steps.name: The Adventurer Who Received an Oracle
steps.objective: Turn in the quest to [Medea] in 「Kali」.

steps.name: An Uneasy Heart
steps.objective: Talk to [Medea] in 「Kali」, then go to 「Adrica」 and talk to [Minuet]. Return to 「Kali」 and turn in the quest to [Medea].

lines.text: (The divine stone beneath the adventurer's hand splits into fragments and scatters across the floor. Startled, Medea quickly catches the staggering adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That doesn't sound like a fun message...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: %s, endure the heat. We're only checking the oracle's contents.
(Lydia lifts Roro from her shoulder and places the spirit on %s's head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...It's warm, not terribly hot.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Really? Askren screamed that he felt like he was being pickled in lava.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: How embarrassing. I was only ninth rank then. I simply had no resistance.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Want me to put Roro on you again?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Haha, no.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How long do I have to keep this spirit on my head?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: That's enough.
(Lydia picks Roro up and returns the spirit to her shoulder. Roro whispers something in her ear.)

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: The one bearing the fate of a Demon God waits in Amaranth Nova. Pierce his heart and destroy him...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: %s, I'll say it once more...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know. I won't hear Iris's voice until the oracle is fulfilled.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: I know you have more to say. Go ahead. It's all right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I defeat him, I'll become a Deicide, someone who killed a god...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: That depends on Barbatos's condition and your own will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does that mean I have to trust in luck?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Don't worry too much. We'll help in our own way to avoid the worst outcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Yes, we...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Askren, wait. I'll explain.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Generally, an oracle forbids direct intervention by others.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Ordinary people who interfere face a punishment bearing the god's wrath. But Demigods carry out divine work, so we have some latitude.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: We still can't do your part for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. There's something else...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Oh, Shynic and Medea. Just to be clear...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I know what you're going to say. Our novice goddess hasn't given permission, so we're not to interfere.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: This concerns Barbatos alone. It can't be helped.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Understood...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Thank you for understanding.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If it's the goddess's will, there's no choice...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: We'll go now. Come, Father Askren. We have much to do.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: We crossed the continent to get here, and we're leaving already? Surely we can have one meal.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: ...Father Askren, you talk far too much. Do you want me angry? Roro is right here.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Let's go. I'll escort you.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: It was a pleasure meeting you all. Until next time, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please give us some notice before your next visit.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: I don't know if it'll be possible, but I'll try. Farewell...
(Lydia and Askren say goodbye to everyone and leave the village.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. I meant to ask where Amaranth Nova is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My head is suddenly so full. I'll take a short walk in Adrika.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'll come. Medea, I'm heading back now.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Take care, Shynic.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Okay. This was fun. Let's work together again next time. Don't do everything alone. All right?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Then I'm really going. Huh, %s? Where did you go? I said we'd go together!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet?
(Minuet encounters the adventurer out for a walk and steps back in mild surprise.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, Minuet. Why are you here? Weren't you traveling?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: ...Blank...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Oh... Hello.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I meant to go elsewhere, but somehow returned to Adrika... I felt I needed to come back...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you sense it, too?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: What do you mean...?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Our novice goddess gave %s an oracle.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: ...Did she? Oh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's left my thoughts in a tangle... I want to talk to Iris, but apparently we can't communicate once an oracle has been issued...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: You trust Iris, don't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Whatever it says, Iris would never want a bad outcome...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: At the very least, it must be a choice made for this world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're right. I was overcomplicating things...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You've got your usual silly expression back. Feeling better?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I want to help, too, but I'm told I can't. This is all I can do. I'll enjoy hearing your story later, so do your best.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, Minuet. Want to live in Tartaros? It'll be more fun than before ♡

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Thank you, Shynic. Not just yet. I'll travel a little more, then visit...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What a shame. I was going to arrange all sorts of fun if you came.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, boring. I'll go to Tartaros. %s, go back to Kali. Medea will worry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Goodbye, everyone ♡ Stay alive until we meet again.
(Shynic finishes her farewell and runs toward Tartaros.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I was going to say goodbye, but I was too late...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're too slow, Minuet. Well, I'll return to Kali now.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I'll go wherever my feet take me again... I don't know where, but I'll be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Minuet.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Goodbye...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Now I should...
(Sensing something strange, Minuet hurriedly runs away. A small black butterfly flies over and lands on her shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: This butterfly... Could it be... Ugh... Was it you who called me...?
(Recognizing the butterfly, Minuet suddenly loses her strength and collapses.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I-I can't move...
(The butterfly leaves Minuet's shoulder and lands on the fingertip of an approaching figure.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: You're... Barbatos...?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: As Gaia's incarnation, you recognize this butterfly and me. It once followed Gaia. After she fell asleep, it must have sought a god, appearing before me while I had no memories.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I made good use of it. You have my thanks for that.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: That frightened look isn't bad, either. Better still if it were Gaia's. But enough small talk...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: P-please... Don't... This...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Much like what I said to them...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: K-Kaulini...
(Barbatos's expression twists at the name. Then he regains his composure and looks at Minuet calmly.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: For now, I will speak as Barbatos.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I bear you no grudge, but I will blind your eyes and deafen your ears. So sleeping Gaia remains trapped in nightmares forever, unable to awaken.

steps.name: A Likely Place
steps.objective: Talk to [Medea] in 「Kali」 and watch all the events. Then go to 「Guild Union City Esnil」 and turn in the quest to [Dayna].

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You look as though you've sorted through your thoughts. Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... Maybe talking to Minuet helped.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Minuet returned?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She was there when I arrived. After we talked, she quietly left again.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I hope nothing happens to her.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Are you leaving now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should. First, I'll gather information...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'm coming.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, this is something only I...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That's right, Hilda. This...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Have you forgotten? I'm different. Our souls...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: They said no one could interfere, but I should be all right. And if I follow at a distance...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still no.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'm following whether you like it or not.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's dangerous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You insist on going?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Don't even think about leaving me alone. I believe this is something I must do, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So stubborn... All right. Come with me. Better than going alone.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: One last favor. Cast the spell that eases my pain. I won't ask like this again...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: We need to meet again, after all.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: All right...
(Medea quietly closes her eyes and gently taps Hilda's shoulder with her staff.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You should be able to hold on for a while... But come back if it gets difficult.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'm good at hiding. If things go wrong, I'll abandon %s and run. Happy?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do what suits you. Now, where is Amaranth Nova...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, could it be...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Have somewhere in mind?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's a city called Linford whose road was blocked ten years ago. It's a fragment of the Celestial Realm, also called the city of angels.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Is it that place? Up the road from the windmill...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Nearby Devesis was connected to Barbatos long ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know it?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: ...I thought a fragment of the Celestial Realm might be somewhere I could hide, but I couldn't even get in.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: And Daphne said the Grand Duke recovered memories of his past and appeared ten years ago.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There seems to be a connection.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Can you still not get in?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard about it from the villagers and went to look. An enormous magical barrier was spread across the road.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's the place I suspect, at least. I'll ask people who might know, then find a way in.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's already late. Why not leave tomorrow?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: One day's leeway should be fine. Let's do as Medea says.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. We'll rest here and leave tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you. I'll prepare somewhere for you to rest. Please have a peaceful evening.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'll say goodbye now, too. I expect to leave early tomorrow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where are you going?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: To speak with Ziskad about Mistwood. I may have overlooked something.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Take care, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I will... Until next time, both of you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good night, Medea...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: ...Medea needs rest, too. She has too much to do.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, who are we seeing first?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someone named Dayna. I don't know if you know her. She met Barbatos ten years ago.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: The Empire's second princess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know her?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: A little. We crossed paths briefly before. She won't know much about me.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Enough talking. Get some rest. We have a long journey starting tomorrow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Go to Esnil when you wake. I'll follow. We'll meet soon, so don't wait around like a child.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Let's travel as safely as possible. Surely Ouroboros won't appear now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ouroboros...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: We'll have a chance to discuss that this time.
(Hilda finishes speaking, turns, and disappears behind Medea's house.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda...
What frightens you so? What do you fear that makes you stand in my way?
If obstructing me is your best choice, I will become your worst moment.
Just as you did, regardless of light or darkness... All of it...
That is how the sin called divinity ends...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think I dreamed something last night...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Someone standing in an unfamiliar place... Who was it? They seemed to be speaking to someone...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Was it Barbatos? Whew. I don't know...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No time for this. Let's hurry. I hope Dayna is there...)

steps.name: A Sealed-Off Fragment of the Celestial Realm
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Dayna] in 「Guild Union City Esnil」, then find [Uriella] in front of 「Tower of Proof」.
2. After talking to [Uriella], turn in the quest to [Irfan] in 「Elysia」.

lines.text: (When %s finishes speaking, Dayna slowly opens her eyes.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: A demon blinded by love spent thousands of years trying to take Barbatos's power. How interesting. And now he's about to become a god...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: An oracle... %s, you have to stop him, but no one else can interfere. That's frustrating...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm one of the people who wants to kill Barbatos, too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dayna...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I spent years growing stronger, eliminating corruption in the shadows. But when Barbatos appeared before me again, I realized...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: He was stronger than ten years ago, and I couldn't stop him...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Perhaps that's why I placed my hopes on you, %s... The only one who could defeat him with the goddess...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Whew. Enough of my feelings. Your question comes first. Sorry...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I don't know whether it was Amaranth Nova, but when Barbatos first appeared, he mentioned a place.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: He held Shiina hostage, saying he had to enter the Celestial Realm where he'd once been and awaken everything...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: He killed my father, then vanished hurriedly as though something had gone wrong...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was Belial nearby...?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Perhaps. A demon who manipulated him at his side for so long could certainly...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does Shiina have some special power? Daphne and Barbatos both spoke that way.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Only an aptitude for wielding magic as a mage... I kept watching to see whether anything happened to her afterward, but nothing major did.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: And I won't let it...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Not long after that incident, I heard there had been an earthquake in Linford and the road was blocked...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I went to check, but a powerful magical barrier left me unable to do anything.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Later, after growing a little stronger, I tried various things. Same result. The one thing I learned...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Was that Linford is under the influence of divine power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That was the limit of what we who cross the shadows could do. There was no one to ask for more.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: But that's not true for you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... Right. The angels. Battle angels who guard gods, though you usually have to fight before they'll talk.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Unusual angels.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Actually, there's one who doesn't fight. Dayna, I'll go now.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Why do you keep looking behind you as we talk? Is someone there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry. I have a companion. She's very shy, so she's hiding.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: An unusual companion.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Tell me whenever I can help. Aaron's disappearance didn't mean everything was over. I was too complacent...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll tell you if anything happens. See you later, Dayna.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Take care.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Barbatos...

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: I'm glad you came to me first among my sisters with your questions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...It's a little daunting having to fight as soon as we meet.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Right? Mika, Rafi, and Gab always start with a fight. Even I find it exhausting. So, what do you want to know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I explain to Uriella why I came.)

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: I suspected some of it, but hearing it from you feels different. And it's been so long since I heard that name.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: He suddenly disappeared, and I wondered where he'd gone. So he was living as a demon called Barbatos.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Enough about him. I'll tell you what you want to know.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: The Demon Realm houses demons born from the abyss and those who follow them. The Celestial Realm was where gods and their followers dwelled.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: It normally remains hidden from people, but after the gods disappeared, parts seem to have emerged as it naturally merged with this world.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Even with the gods gone, those fragments of the Celestial Realm retained their power. That's probably how they endured so long.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: But another power's influence can change them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then...

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: I think Amaranth Nova appeared along with Barbatos. A star of the abyss appearing in a place filled with divine power...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A star of the abyss...?

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: You know about Novas.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An evil mage I defeated once called one 'a star of the abyss that pours out every wound and tear.'

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Sounds like he deserved a lesson.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: In any case, if Linford changed because its divine power mixed with the demonic power left by an abyssal star, something is strange...

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: If it became such a place, the continent of Freios beneath our feet should already be gone. A mere earthquake wouldn't have been the end of it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: If I could leave here, I'd investigate for you. Angels can act independently of an oracle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for offering. I'll handle the rest.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: All right. Where will you go now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm still thinking...

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: What about Elysia? A divine place you can enter freely...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... I'll try it.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Hold still a moment. Take my greeting before you go.
(Uriella approaches and gently kisses the adventurer's cheek.)

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Hehe. Still surprised. Come see me again once this is resolved.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I promise, Uriella. I'll go now.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Take care.
(Seeing the adventurer off, Uriella closes her eyes at the sight of someone following them quietly.)

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: ...No helping it. I'll overlook this.

steps.name: A Fussy Old Man
steps.objective: Talk to [Irfan] in 「Elysia」, then obtain an <S-Rank Peridot> in 「Blind Bird's Nest」. Then turn in the quest to [Irfan] in 「Elysia」.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Irfan.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It's been a while, old man.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: After causing all that commotion, you two come together... So it must be that matter.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: That saves an explanation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We came to ask for help.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I know what you mean. Normally I'd shout and send you away, but I'll make an exception.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: If you have any good-quality jewels from magical beasts, share them with me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Like peridots?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Yes, those. If you have none, fetch some. I'll explain after I receive them.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Exactly five would be good.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Such a demanding old man...

steps.name: Why We Need Time
steps.objective: Talk to [Irfan] in 「Elysia」, then go to 「Nameless Place」 and watch all the events. Then turn in the quest to [Raselis] in 「Devesis」.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Fine jewels. They'll make good gifts for my family when they're reborn... Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did you ask for these?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I needed a little time.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Time?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Go to where you caused that commotion before.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Could it be...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You'll understand when you go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. We'll go.
(Hecate gazes at the distant sky with lonely eyes, then closes them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hecate.
(Hecate opens her eyes and looks at the approaching pair.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Hilda, following the mortal back to Elysia... You must have made a great resolve.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Did you borrow Medea's power?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I had no choice.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I see. I, too, have no choice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: The girl loved by Gaia and Seres, who became the God of the Astral Realm... Iris has made a momentous choice.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: To issue you an oracle to destroy Barbatos, who was Kaulini.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You do not fully understand what that means.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Her rejecting my proposal is one thing. But an oracle is a god's command to a mortal...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: From that moment, she moves closer to being a god. And can no longer return to being human.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: She must have chosen the best path available from where she stands.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: That is all I wished to say. Expect no help from me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But Hecate...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Had Iris accepted my proposal, I might have thought differently.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Hilda, you have questions for me, too. But you know I am not easily swayed.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Do not forget. I am a god. The one who gave you the fate of witches...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: And the reason I awakened to watch these events...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Enough. Let us end this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hecate, Hilda and I are going to a fragment of the Celestial Realm...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Menoiti, I will withdraw. If you wish to do something, do as you please.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Menoiti?
(Hecate's figure disperses like smoke and vanishes. A moment later, a boy carrying a chalice approaches from the path behind them and taps %s's shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Hello, Hilda and %s.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: What's a short Twisted One doing here?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Hilda, that hurts.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How are you here, Menoiti...?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: This is Elysia. Don't worry about little details. Hecate really can't be honest with herself.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: I came here to do nothing, and she called me away from my rest, only to disappear.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: She clearly said to do as I please. So I may, right?
(Menoiti smiles brightly and lifts his cup toward the sky.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Come on. I'll help.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait...
I wish it were a lie... It has to stop... Everyone will be in danger...
Was it a trap?
I... I never wanted this...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Wake up, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, yes.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You saw a vision?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A horned woman with sad eyes...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Yes. Do you know her?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. But she feels familiar... Where are we?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: On the road to where you wanted to go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: In front of the windmill on Whispering Hill...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Menoiti, was it? Did you see the vision, too?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: It was displayed openly while I brought you here. Of course I saw it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know who she is?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: I don't know the name of every spirit in the world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A spirit...?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Yes, a spirit. Oh, you can't tell just by looking. Anyway, someone seems to want you two to see this.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: You'd like to know who, but I don't know, either. Everyone has their own abilities.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Juriring, stop hiding and come here.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Juriring. I'm Menoiti.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Menoiti, Menoiti... I've heard of you, ring. A god who disappeared long, long ago, ring.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Ancient history. Now I'm just a short Twisted One with barely a name left.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: A T-T-Twisted One, ring! I've never seen one, ring! And a short one, too!

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Wow, a giant Priring... Not an ordinary Priring, surely...
(Hilda naturally strokes Juriring's head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris said it's a kind of Spirit King.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Juriring, may I put a drop of water on your jewel? It'll shine even more brightly.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Yes, please, ring.
(Menoiti gently shakes his cup. A sparkling droplet rises and lands on Juriring's jewel.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Wow... It's so shiny, ring. One moment, ring.
(Juriring blinks and polishes the jewel with a wing.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I only just cheered, but I should try again, ring. What should I say?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Wish for everyone's happiness and well-being as usual. I'll handle the rest.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: All right, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Ring, ring. Be happy, ring. Stay healthy, ring, ring.
(Juriring lifts and shakes the jewel toward the sky. Gentle light blooms and spreads.)
(At that moment, Menoiti raises his arm. The light gathers from the sky and fills his cup.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: O star of twisted fate.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: O star loved and praised by all, bearing a destiny of destruction.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Menoiti, who cherished you, speaks...

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Part the barrier concealing this place, and welcome the approaching light...
(At Menoiti's words, the light in his cup surges into the shape of a dragon. It soars into the sky and strikes something enormous.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: That seems to have done it.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: What did you do?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: I did my part, and priests elsewhere were using their power. It worked out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Priests...?)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: The door to the fragment of the Celestial Realm is open. You can go now.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Amazing, ring. No one could do it before, ring. Oh, %s, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Oh, right, %s, ring. I said I'd tell you about Kaulini, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: The Kaulini I saw was wrapped in the presence of destruction, ring. He looked as though he'd destroy the world, ring.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: He killed many gods in anger, ring. As many as the Beast killed, ring.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: That hurt a lot.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You survived...

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Survived, or escaped well, perhaps. Juriring, you've lived a long time. You remember that.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I have a good memory, ring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is that why his head and leg are bandaged...?)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Belial's deception was part of it, but I think there was something more, ring.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I don't know, ring. I've never left this hill, so I don't know, ring.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: That seems to be the end of the story. Off you go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Meno, why are you helping?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: You think this is helping? You really know nothing about the Twisted Ones.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: If I change my mind, I may obstruct you like last time. Stop hesitating and go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Oh, Juriring, where's Elliot?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: It's mealtime, so he'll be at the Cloud's Threshold, ring.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: I'll play with Juriring here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. See you later.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Bye.
(Juriring sees Hilda and the adventurer off, then looks at Menoiti, who is stroking it.)

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Menoiti, what shall we play, ring?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Juriring, want to visit Atlas Garden? There's an amusing friend there, too.

steps.name: Through the Clouds
steps.objective:
1. Have the conversation in front of [Raselis] in 「Devesis」, then use the portal in 「Whispering Hill」 to enter 「Aether Road」.
2. Defeat [Experienced Jeruna] on 「Aether Road」, then turn in the quest to [Hailey] on 「Aether Road」.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Patello drains all my motivation... Just hurry up and leave...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Chef, we can hear you...

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Oh, I was talking to myself. Don't worry about it, Elliot.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Really...?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: It's fine, it's fine. Guests in our village needn't worry.

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Oh, Chef Raselis. Once I finish this, I'll look at your broken oven and the hole in the roof.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Yes. Please do.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: ...The oven never gets a rest because of Patello. Neither do the roofs around the village.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: It was scary when something fell from the sky...

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: No need to be frightened. I thought magical beasts or demons were attacking at first, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, everyone. Here you all are.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Hello, %s.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Where have you been? Hungry?

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Master said you were leaving the village briefly. You're back already. Sit down and eat first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where's Elliot?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I-I'm... right here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, sorry, Elliot. I didn't see you. Have you finished eating?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I have. Did you need to tell me something...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's somewhere we need to go together.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Oh, the magical beasts' nest?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Huh?

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Wow, Elliot. Impressive. So brave...

lines.speaker: 파텔로
lines.text: Have a safe trip. Take some food, just in case. I'll tell Master.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Thank you... I'll explore properly this time...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, everyone.

lines.speaker: 슈비에
lines.text: Bye, %s.

lines.speaker: 라셀리스
lines.text: Please come again.
(Outside the restaurant, Elliot recognizes Hilda waiting and startles.)

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Oh, Hilda?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Hello...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Long time no see, crybaby.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: It's been so long, and that's how you greet me...?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: We're going to Linford. We need you to guide us.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: What? Linford?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The blocked road seems to be open.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: How...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll explain on the way.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Until recently, all I could do was look from here...
(Elliot lowers his head and finally lets his tears fall.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes... I'm fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I needed to do something, so someone helped me...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Someone who did what no one else could must be truly wonderful and remarkable...?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot, which way is Linford?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Straight ahead. There are several branches, but they're all blocked.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: But Aether Road looks just as it used to... What could have happened?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: We'll have to go and see.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You say you left Linford three years ago, but this road has been blocked for ten. Clearly something's wrong.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much, Elliot.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I'll be brave.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You can hide well, like when you explored the beasts' nest, right?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Aether Road isn't that dangerous... It's just a road with little Prirings...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Elliot. Look.
(The clouds filling the road retreat, slowly revealing previously hidden monsters.)

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I've never seen those...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: If they're water spirits from the river...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A river...?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: They look familiar. I'm not sure...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: ...Will Linford be all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Linford will be all right, Elliot.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes... Hearing you say that is reassuring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot, follow behind and guide us.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: All right... This way, everyone...

steps.name: A Cursed City
steps.objective: Talk to [Hailey] on 「Aether Road」, then defeat [Shrinel of Despair]. Turn in the quest to [Hailey] on 「Aether Road」.

lines.text: The air has changed... Why? The clouds have hardly ever cleared...
(An elven woman brushes back her long green hair, quietly closes her eyes, and gently touches the air.)
...People are coming, not monsters. Unbelievable. Real people...
Who could...?
(The elf tightens her grip on her staff and leaps toward the approaching figures.)
Crash!
(With a sound loud enough to fill the road, the staff strikes the ground and leaves a great hole.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow... If Hilda hadn't pulled me away, that would've been bad...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: This isn't the time to admire it. Are you all right?
You there. Identify yourselves.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Ah... Y-you startled me. H-Hailey?
(The elf called Hailey looks at Elliot in surprise.)

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Oh? You're Benjamin's youngest son, right? You left Linford ten years ago... You're back.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: But why haven't you aged? I understand looking young when you're Benjamin's son, but...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: How did you get in? No one has entered or left in ten years.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Well... These people helped me...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: The only way in should be from Whispering Hill... Did you come from there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Really? Wait here a moment.
(Before her words have faded, Hailey runs down the road toward Whispering Hill.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot, who is she?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: An elf who visited the village before I left to travel. She stayed at our house briefly, so I know her a little.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I think she said she's a high elf who hunts demons and witches...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I'll keep quiet. I wouldn't mention Dorothy Village, but I'm afraid I might slip...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It'll be fine, Elliot.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: A troublesome woman. I should have hidden first... There are a few elves like her among the Order's hardliners...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: She's coming. Quiet, everyone.
(Hailey races back at full speed and stops before them.)

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Whew. Still can't get out. It seems you were specially allowed in. Have you checked whether you can leave?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, not yet...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I did. Don't worry. You and I can leave...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Hailey, they're good people. Please don't suspect them...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: %s has helped in many places... They defeated the evil witch who appeared in Lifthrasir.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: You helped Lif?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know the director. Whenever she gets a chance, she asks me to become a resident of Lifthrasir. It's quite an ordeal.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Calling it an ordeal makes you sound genuine. If Lif pushed that hard, you must be someone remarkable.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: So you're %s? And the one with mismatched eyes is Hilda? Nice to meet you. I'm Hailey. Just call me that. Welcome.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: I won't ask why you're here. You must have something to do...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: It's difficult, but I'll tell you Linford's secret, one only I know. This is a curse...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Whew... After ten years, I can finally tell someone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A curse?

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Yes... The people left here think the curse simply prevents them from leaving. To me, it means something else.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: I clear out these monsters every day to try to forget it, but it's not easy. Spirits connected to death wander here, too...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Let's deal with the monsters causing trouble nearby first. Then I'll explain the curse.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll help...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Thank you. Let's finish quickly.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'll wait here with Elliot.

steps.name: Linford, 10 Years Ago
steps.objective: Talk to [Hailey] on 「Aether Road」, then defeat [Cupola of Joy]. Turn in the quest to [Ariel] on 「Aether Road」.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Good work. This lets Linford's people have better dreams.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will you explain why the curse means something different to you?

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Yes. Whether you believe it is your choice, %s...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Ten years ago, I came to Linford pursuing a demon I considered my mortal enemy. I couldn't find it and was about to leave, thinking I'd wasted my time...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: But an unknown, powerful force had made it impossible for anyone to leave.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: As I returned to the village to investigate, the ground began shaking and splitting.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: And bottomless black holes appeared beneath Linford.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: The enormous city of angels floating in the sky split under that power and fell toward the holes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Let's keep listening.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: I tried to save the people falling into them, but it happened too quickly. There was nothing I could do.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: I struggled upward, stepping on falling rubble. But as it continued, my strength reached its limit.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Then I missed a step and nearly fell into a black hole... A woman with white wings appeared and caught my hand.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: A real angel in the city of angels, saving me... It felt so dreamlike that I closed my eyes without thinking.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Everything went quiet. When it became noisy again, I opened my eyes...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: And stood in the center of Linford, intact, just as before. Everyone was still there.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: No one knew black holes had appeared. It was as though everything had been restored, and only I remembered.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: I hurried to leave, but couldn't, just like now.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: The people only knew their city was cursed and they couldn't go outside...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Now you understand how my curse differs from theirs...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's hard to believe. Then the people in Linford now...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I think it's true. Those people might be...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: That's why I said believing it is your choice. Whew... I feel better after saying it.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: I couldn't tell anyone properly. No one believed me...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: I even doubted myself. But later, I saw an angel fly toward Whispering Hill and return. Then I knew.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: I followed to ask, but she vanished quickly. She appeared now and then afterward, seemingly searching for a way out...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: At some point, she stopped appearing. Maybe she gave up. I think she's still somewhere in Linford...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: If even an angel can't do anything, a power greater than hers must be at work here.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: I suspected it... Divine power, then...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: If someone did this, I want to meet them and ask why. Sigh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Still hard to believe, but I need to check.)

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Oh, and afterward, a place appeared off to one side that wasn't there before.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: It resembles part of Linford, but feels different. I can't approach easily.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: When I try, it keeps moving farther away, as though denying entry. I can never reach it.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: And... It looks frozen at the moment I survived.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're speaking calmly, but it must have been terribly hard.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Perhaps because high elves live so long. Easier than for a human, I suppose.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Shall we take a look?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: I'd like to guide you, but I have work to do. I need to return to the village first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: And Elliot.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Keep this story secret from the villagers.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Oh, yes... I understand...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: %s, Hilda, may I go to the village first? There's something I want to check...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course, Elliot.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Go see your family. We'll talk later.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Thank you both... I'll go ahead.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: ...See you two later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that the place Hailey mentioned? It resembles the village in the distance...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Let's go see.

steps.name: The Truth Hidden in the City
steps.objective: Talk to [Ariel] on 「Aether Road」, then visit [Benjamin], [Kirill], and [Charlotte] in 「Linford」 in that order. Once all conversations are over, return to [Ariel] on 「Aether Road」 and turn in the quest.

lines.text: Who keeps showing me useless things...? It bothers me, but I should just go.
(In a quiet part of Aether Road, a woman stands before a forbidden area with an annoyed expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This seems to be it.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Oh, someone's there. But what are those wings...?
(The woman meets their eyes and steps back in surprise. Covering her shoulders, she tries to flee, but Hilda quickly catches her.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why are you running?
Aaagh! Please let go of my wings... I mean, my clothes! You appeared so suddenly that I was startled...
I've never seen you before. How did you come to Linford? No one can enter or leave because of the curse...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We came on business. About those wings on your back...
Ahaha, wings...? What wings? What are you talking about? Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: The things on your back that look half-grown. Black feather tips... Like a pigeon or a seagull...
That's rather rude for someone I've just met...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Definitely reacting to the wings. A winged demon?
How rude for someone blessed by a god. My wings are nothing like a demon's! And Hailey would have killed me already if I were one!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're an angel, aren't you?
N-no. Just a being... A woman trapped by Linford's curse while traveling. A-Ariel, that's all.
A human woman in her late twenties, about 160 centimeters tall, who likes walks...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Ordinary people don't specifically call themselves human. And why does that introduction sound like a character profile?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you have a nickname, Ariel? All the battle angels I know call themselves by pet names. Would yours be 'Ar'? 'Ar does this,' 'Ar does that'...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Please, I'm begging you. Not every angel talks like those idiots. Sob... Please...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Oh... I blew it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ariel, let me introduce myself. I'm %s... I came here under an oracle. Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: ...I'm Hilda. You're the angel Hailey mentioned?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Yes, but I...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You seem to have your reasons. Help us, and I'll take them into account. You're free to refuse, but I wonder how the God of the Astral Realm would react later...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I've been living here without doing any angelic duties at all. And now you suddenly say that...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: No other option, is there? Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good. It's a promise.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: ...You're better at that than I expected.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Oh, I'm doomed... But I thought the seat of the God of the Astral Realm was vacant...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know nothing about the last ten years? Because you've been here, I suppose...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly explain that Iris became the God of the Astral Realm.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I see. But why have you come to Amaranth Nova?
(As the adventurer explains, Ariel quietly turns her gaze forward.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Yes, this is the place. Where an enormous star from the abyss, summoned by divine power, rose and fell...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Powerful divine forces operate here. If you want to enter, you must listen to the being within.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: But who could that be...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos. No, Kaulini.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I'd rather not talk about him...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: If you want to hear my story, visit the village first. You'll understand when you do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Can angels not speak freely about gods? Some kind of rule...?
(Ariel continues speaking, but no sound comes out.)
(She lowers her head in resignation.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No choice... Hilda, let's visit the village as Ariel says.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: So much being hidden.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Nothing. Let's go...
Elliot, your father never forgot your face in all ten years... I'm so glad you're back.
(Elliot can hold back no longer and bursts into tears. A man with a similar air pats his shoulder.)
You've been through so much. I'm sorry I couldn't come find you...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: No... I missed you so much...
We must tell Liana this wonderful news. But you know your sister hates being interrupted while working.
The general store closes in the evening. Let's wait until then.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: What...? Dad, my sister...
This still feels strange. You left Linford at fourteen. Ten years later, you're seventeen...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: It's strange for me, too. It's only been three years for me, but you say ten...
I don't understand, either. Where did the rest of the time go...?
Still, I should be grateful I can see you again before you're fully grown.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Dad, do you remember the day the curse began ten years ago?
I do. The ground shook terribly, like an earthquake.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Anything else?
Hmm. I don't remember anything else. Nothing much must have happened.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: There's Elliot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that his brother? They look alike.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Oh, %s. Hilda. You came to the village. Hailey brought me here, then went elsewhere.
Elliot, are these the people...?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes, Dad. They helped me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dad? Your father?

lines.speaker: 벤자민
lines.text: I-I'm Benjamin. I heard you've helped my son Elliot a great deal... Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello... I'm %s. I thought you were his brother, so that surprised me.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'm Hilda.

lines.speaker: 벤자민
lines.text: It's been so long since I met outsiders that I'm a little nervous... Elliot said the road opened, but it seems we still can't leave...

lines.speaker: 벤자민
lines.text: When will we be able to leave...? Everyone in Linford, myself included, had given up. Seeing you gives me a little hope...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry I can't explain in detail...

lines.speaker: 벤자민
lines.text: Not at all. I'm grateful simply to see Elliot again. Linford will manage somehow.

lines.speaker: 벤자민
lines.text: I hope your stay is peaceful. Tell me if you need help. I'll do anything I can.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Dad...

lines.speaker: 벤자민
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: May I talk to these two for a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Perfect. I was about to ask Elliot to show us around.

lines.speaker: 벤자민
lines.text: Go talk and look around, Elliot. It's been so long... I won't go anywhere. Come back when you have time.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: All right. I'll be back...
(Once Benjamin enters the house, Elliot breaks into a cold sweat and sinks to the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I couldn't help it... Maybe because of Hailey's story... He's definitely Dad, but it feels strange. And...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: No, never mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell us. It's all right.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: ...His memories are wrong. My sister Liana married and lives in Glaston... She worked at the general store before her marriage...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Hmm. Distorted memories...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We should see whether anything is strange about the other villagers, too...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: If Kiril still has the same job, he'll be at the shop.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Lots of people visit the general store. We can hear all sorts of things...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Wait a moment. I'll go check...

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: Elliot, you're still exactly the same. Just like ten years ago. Is it because you inherited Benjamin's young face?

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: Welcome. Oh, outsiders? You must be the people Elliot mentioned.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes, Kiril.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot said he'd greet you first so we wouldn't startle you.

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: Haha, it's fine. But I don't have much useful information...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Kiril, just tell us what you remember from ten years ago...

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: I can barely remember what I ate a few days ago, and you want ten years... I'll try.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What was the day the city was cursed like?

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: There was something like an earthquake.

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: I was afraid it would ruin the shop I'd invested everything in, so I just sat down and clung to it.

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: Embarrassing, but I couldn't think what else to do.

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: It felt like we were falling, and I was frightened. But the shaking soon stopped.

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: I thought I'd receive the goods from other regions the next day, then learned we were trapped.

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: Then I thought I really was ruined. Somehow, I've held on until now.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Do you remember what goods you ordered and where from?

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: I think they were ingredients for something popular then... Strange. I can't remember clearly.

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: What was it...?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Those cookies popular in Glaston? You bought up ingredients from several cities to make them... Was that it?

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: Oh, yes. I think so. Paid an enormous amount for them, didn't I...?

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: Haha, this happens sometimes. I'm no longer young, so I forget things.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: They all say similar things.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They last saw Elliot ten years ago, so why does he still look the same? The ground shook that day, but nothing else happened...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They seem to be telling the truth, but there's another common thread.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Their memories are mixed up... Three years ago... No, ten years ago from their perspective. There seem to be wrong memories...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: And some parts seem erased...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Kiril's memory wasn't real, either... I just made up the cookies...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I wanted to try them. So they were imaginary.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... But who are you? Why do you keep following us?
I've never seen you before. I'm curious.
(A young girl walks beside %s's busy group, watching them with interest.)
I'm Charlotte.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Oh, are you Charl?

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: Yes... Do you know me?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I think you were only a baby when I left to travel...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot, do you know her?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: In Linford, when a baby is born, people visit the home and give handwritten letters.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I greeted Charl when she was newborn. Do other people's children really grow so fast?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: She must be over ten already... It's finally sinking in. Time passed strangely for me...

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: Mr. Benjamin's runaway son?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I didn't run away...

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: You came from outside...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, outside.

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: Won't you ask me anything?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: It's about ten years ago. You were too young to remember... Sorry...

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: I think I can tell you something interesting.

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: I've been seeing strange things... It's hard to explain... They started appearing in the city.

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: Mom didn't know, so she told me to ask the old man next door. He said they're spirits that live in water.

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: They want to drag dead people into the river...

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: But the people of Linford and I are alive... Strange, isn't it?

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: Other people don't believe me, but Teacher Hailey does. When I tell her, she goes out to the road...

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: She seems to be hunting something secretly. Those spirits, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. I can't tell you.

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: It's all right. Adults are always like that... Everything's a secret.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you keep the secret, I'll show you a giant Priring later. You seem to like Prirings... It looks something like this.

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: There's a Priring that big...? With wings? Oh, I want to see it... It'd be fun to meet...

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: Promise?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I promise. Elliot, please take her home. If we learn anything, I'll tell you later.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes... I will.

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: Promise.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: ...I'll tell you about a funny-talking herb spirit, too, besides that Priring. Charl, I'll walk you home. Come on.

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: Okay. Let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Elliot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And Hilda...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go see Ariel.

steps.name: A Spirit Revived
steps.objective: Talk to [Ariel] on 「Aether Road」, then follow [Ellone], who has disappeared, and talk to her. After talking to [Ellone], return to [Ariel] on 「Aether Road」 and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Sigh... How long will I be unable to speak...? Oh?
(Startled, Ariel looks around and sees %s's group running toward her.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Y-you're back?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ariel, you can speak now.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Have you learned something?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not exactly, but everyone's memories are slightly out of step.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They seem distorted, yet the people don't notice much wrong.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: And outsiders arriving after ten years should cause a stir, but it barely does. Most should react like Hailey.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Whew. Thank goodness. I was afraid you wouldn't notice...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: We're not fools. It's obviously strange.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: You notice because of who you are... No one here besides Hailey and me thinks it's strange...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Only someone like Kaulini could fall into the abyss and rise again.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: The city and lives restored by a god like that are incomplete. He can recreate the city's appearance, but cannot bring back the dead...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: So he drew the river of death here and spent a long time pulling drifting souls from it...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Linford and its lives are barely being maintained. Trapped in a fragment of the Celestial Realm, living an eternity with distorted memories...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I don't know what Kaulini wants this place to be, but it will probably continue like this.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: The fortunate things are that he failed to notice Hailey and me... and that he properly saved Charlotte's soul...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: He must have been unable to let the city's youngest child's soul drift away. He barely saved her, but since then Charl has seen spirits...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: In any case, I had no choice but to stay silent. That way, the people here could live without knowing the truth.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I'm glad you came. Someone I can finally tell...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And that makes you feel better?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: A little...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Angels may transcend life, but these people are alive without truly living...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know it isn't your fault, Ariel. But I can't call that the best choice.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: As a powerless being, she had no choice. An incompetent angel, after all...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I appreciate the understanding, but I'm not incompetent. Just unmotivated...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: The god you served...?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Probably destroyed by the Beast or Kaulini during the age called the Twilight.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Enough of my dull story. Just think about what you'll do next.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: And pretend you never saw me. I'm an incompetent angel, after all. Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Incompetent angel Ariel, can we enter Amaranth Nova now?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: His presence in Linford has recognized you, but I don't know whether you can enter. Try walking forward.
(At that moment, sharp plant branches begin gathering behind Ariel.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ariel, come here! It's dangerous!

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: What? Aaagh!
(In an instant, branches coil around Ariel's arms, legs, and neck, tightening slowly.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Ugh... Why me...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ariel, hold on! Hilda, help! Who's doing this...?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Careful. Someone's there.
(Someone slowly emerges between great broken branches.)
(A woman holds a softly glowing lamp in one hand and a sharp, icy sword in the other.)
Angel, you should have kept silent, as you have until now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that Lauma? No, Giltine...? Neither...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: E-Ellone... If only you hadn't gone to Belial then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellone...?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: That is all in the past.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you here?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: He called me. I became ash in Belial's mirror and was cast onto the earth, but he awakened me again.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Ellone, don't do this here.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: I don't want to hear it...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: You wanted to save everyone. Belial used you to corrupt Kaulini...

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: At that time, I... I... Oh, my memories...?
(The lamp in Ellone's hand shatters. Its flame falls to the ground and begins burning the surroundings.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: N-no! If we leave it, the fire will spread to Linford!

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: I did that...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could it be...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellone, weren't you suffering? Blaming yourself? Belial used you, but you said you never wanted it. That it was a trap...

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: ...I... I only...
(Ellone stammers, turns away, and runs off.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, follow that spirit, Ellone or whatever she's called.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Only Ellone can put out this fire! It's dangerous to leave it!

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Whew. Calm down and look at me, Ariel.
(Hilda holds Ariel and quietly seats her on the ground. She takes out a dagger, cuts her thumb, and lets a drop of blood fall.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I didn't want to see blood again, but there's no choice...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Don't tell me, you're...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Sorry. Be quiet.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Did I do that...?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: I have no memories...

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: A being imperfectly restored in a space made to resemble its original form...

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Kaulini, could your current state be...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you muttering to yourself?
(Ellone turns and stares at the approaching adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't we have things to discuss?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: I'll speak first. I will lead you to him, but you cannot meet him simply because you wish to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't expect it to be easy.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Come find me in the River of Hatred and Oaths. Then you'll understand naturally.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: If you refuse...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I refuse?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: You will lose Linford and everything you love.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hostages and threats... Is that the kind of god Kaulini wants to be?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: I cannot answer that question.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: When you've decided, ask the angel for the way to the river. I'll wait at its end.
(As Ellone finishes, a black butterfly flies in from nowhere, turns into a veil of darkness, and swallows her.)
(It rises into the sky and vanishes without a trace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I suppose getting through without a fight was never likely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's return to Ariel...
(After everyone leaves, something rises from beneath the road's bridge, beating black wings.)
(She slowly surveys the surroundings and smiles.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I like it. Not bad for a stage made by an incomplete being... Then or now...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Though nothing satisfies me quite as much as you.
(Belial strokes her mirror. Barbatos appears in it, on his way somewhere.)
(His gaze meets hers through the mirror. He sneers and aims his pistol.)
Crash.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Hehe. Such a difficult man...
(Belial catches the bullet that passes through the mirror and grazes her face, then drops it to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I'll come watch you crumble soon. Wait for me. My Kaulini, belonging to no one else...

steps.name: The River of Death
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Ariel] on 「Aether Road」, then enter 「River of Hatred and Oaths」.
2. Defeat [Ellone] in 「River of Hatred and Oaths」. Leave through the reward room, then turn in the quest to [Ariel] on 「Aether Road」.

lines.text: (Blood from Hilda's fingertip touches a sharp plant stem. It stops moving, then rapidly burrows into the ground and disappears.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Whew. Done... Ariel, you're all right?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Thank you. You saved me.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Hilda... Are you going to interfere with the oracle?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: ...Would you say I already have...?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: That's not what I meant...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: We'll see.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I thought you were just an incompetent angel, but surprisingly...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Well, I am an angel. And I'm not incompetent. The job simply doesn't suit me. Oh, %s is coming.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you two all right?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Are you? What happened to Ellone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She told me to find her in the River of Hatred and Oaths, then disappeared.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Then you'll have to go. You can't defy the oracle. That could make things more dangerous...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Are you prepared?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Hilda, you mustn't go to the river.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: It's called the River of Hatred and Oaths now, but in truth it's the river of death.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Souls whose lives have ended and who have no bodies left surrender to its waters. After a time of rest, they're sent into the world again.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: They lose their former memories in the process... A law even gods cannot defy...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Even gods...)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Someone seems to have cast a spell protecting your two souls. But going together would be dangerous.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: There's a high chance one of you would be recognized as a soul of the dead. You'd unknowingly jump into the river to undergo purification.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: The rules of the ordinary world don't apply there...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Not time yet, perhaps...? Sorry, %s. Go alone this time.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: (Amaranth Nova should be fine...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. Nothing to apologize for.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Then how can Ellone be there?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: The river still fulfills its role, but Kaulini's will reaches part of it.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: He pulled out many souls and revived them ten years ago, and recently revived Ellone, too. That's why she can go to the riverbank.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. One more thing. Why is it called the River of Hatred and Oaths?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Long ago, Kaulini hated the gods who caused his fall and swore to judge them... Right there...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: There may be more, but that's all I know.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You certainly know a lot, Ariel.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Well, I'm an angel... Oh, you keep drawing me in, Hilda. I just did my work quietly...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Ariel. So I take the path ahead...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Wait, %s.
(Ariel quietly takes %s's hand and lightly kisses its back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...? Wh-what?!

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: ...I-I worked up the courage to give you an angel's greeting...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... Like the battle angels' kisses on the cheek. Thank you, Ariel.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Now, I've told you everything I know. Please pretend you never saw me. I'll go home and quietly do nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ariel, I'll be back. We'll talk afterward. Sorry.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'll keep Ariel here.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Your souls are alike, and you're equally annoying. Sigh. Fine...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go. The River of Hatred and Oaths... The river of death...
(Violet sky and land, an endless river, and moonlight flowing like melted silver capture the adventurer's gaze.)
(With each step, fragrance rises from the flowers underfoot and brushes their nose.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Heavens...
Splash.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never imagined a place like this...
Splash... Splash...

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Surely you don't intend to let your soul perish here without even reaching him...
(Startled by the approaching lamplight, the adventurer looks around and steps back.)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Fall that way and you'll lose your memories. Wait a moment.
(Ellone lifts her lamp to illuminate the surroundings. The water around %s's feet disperses and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (When did I walk into the water...?)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Slowly. Come up along the path between the flowers.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellone.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why help me?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Who knows? I merely follow my master's will. I don't particularly consider it helping.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks to you, I got out safely.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Good...
(Ellone checks %s's condition after they leave the water, then turns away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. Where are you going?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: To the place where I should be waiting for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean...?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: First, we must see whether you're ready... They will come now.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: When my master was dragged here and cast into the river by those he trusted... the worst emotions a god could harbor flowed into it, too.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: The spirits here must have been thrown into confusion by those feelings.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Some received his disappointment and anger toward the other gods. For others, it became the reason they had no choice but to go to the Demon Realm...
(Ellone raises her blue-burning lamp toward the moon hanging over the river's end.)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: The spirits here await you.
(At her words, spirits concealed by the lamp's light slowly reveal themselves.)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: They will test whether you can bear... all those emotions...

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: I can only hope you make it through them... Otherwise, this river will sweep you away to somewhere unknown...
(The lamp's flame goes out. In that instant, the moonlight filling the space and Ellone's presence disappear.)
(As moonlight spreads once more, as though the moon awakens, every spirit among the flowers and in the river turns toward one point.)
(%s runs, avoiding spirits climbing from the river onto the path. Moonlight reveals white butterflies flying swiftly after them.)
(As once before, the butterflies cover the adventurer like a vast veil. Within it flickers the blue light of what seems to be Ellone's lamp.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellone.
(The flame burns away the white veil, revealing the violet river with moonlight flowing over it once more.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you make the spirits retreat?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: They remain where they were. We are simply somewhere else. In any case, I've seen your resolve.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Now you will see the resolve of Ellone, the spirit who follows her master's will.
(The flame in Ellone's lamp burns ever more fiercely.)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: ...I will never repeat the mistake of falling to a demon's touch.
(The ice sword in her other hand releases an intense chill.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ugh. Different from Lauma and Giltine in the mirror. Stronger than before...)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Let us begin. I will be different from that wretched self within the mirror.
(The ice blade falls to the ground with a great crash. The blue flame flowing from the lamp stops burning and evaporates.)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: I'm sorry I doubted the skill of someone who fought Belial as an equal... Your resolve exceeds mine. So this is the result.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now open the way to Amaranth Nova.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: I'll guide you, as promised.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I trust you?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Without me, you can neither meet him nor save Linford...

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: After I send you alone to him...
(A familiar-looking great mirror appears before Ellone and %s. A woman slowly steps out.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: No wonder I couldn't reach Kaulini.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is Belial here...?

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Hold still a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? My body...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Ellone, send me to him instead of that human. You said only one can go.
(Belial smiles softly at the motionless adventurer, then strokes her mirror while looking at Ellone.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Ellone, now. I don't repeat myself.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: As a demon, you've already repeated dozens, hundreds of lies.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Don't test my patience. Even revived by his hand, you're only a worthless spirit to me...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: You know what happens if you defy me. You'll suffer worse than %s is now.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I will see him first, not you. %s, enjoy what time you have left. There are plenty of spirits to play with you in this river without Ellone.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Lady Belial, take my hand. I'll lead you there.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I'm glad you understand.
(As Belial takes Ellone's hand, thick black vines rise from the ground and bind their hands together.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: A foolish trick. Do you think something this feeble can hold me?

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Huh? Ugh... Let go!
(More thick vines rise from another direction, binding Belial's arms and legs so she cannot move.)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: This spot will do...
(The place beneath Ellone and Belial instantly changes into the edge of a cliff.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, Ellone. What are you planning...?

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Ridiculous, Ellone. Struggling like this. Why not stop now? How will you face the consequences? Mmph? Mmmph!
(Ellone approaches and covers Belial's mouth. Thick vines wrap around them both.)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Belial, you told me so many lies... I've told only one. Is that too much?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: I'll erase the memories of you and the Twilight, and go to a world where I'll never awaken.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Then that person can go meet him.
(Holding Belial, Ellone looks at the river flowing beneath the cliff.)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Kaulini...

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: To make my complete annihilation the condition for opening Amaranth Nova...

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: If this is your will, and this will earn forgiveness for my sin back then...
