(The river ripples beneath violet moonlight, and small droplets leap toward Ellone.)
Splash.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gasp!
(A white butterfly lands on %s's head. Their entirely white vision returns to normal.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I followed Ellone, then met Belial, and Ellone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah...
(Where Ellone stood moments ago remain marks like severed thick branches.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: For Ellone, did every choice that opened Amaranth Nova lead to death...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
(The little white butterfly on %s's head slowly flies forward, then returns, again and again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As though it's telling me to go that way...)
(As I step toward it, the butterfly stops returning and flies straight ahead.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think I can see Linford in the distance... It seems I can leave now...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Can I enter Amaranth Nova now? What's Barbatos doing there...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Sigh. I'll have to get out and find out...)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: How dare she... Cough, cough...
(With a pained expression, Belial slowly crawls from the river.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: So this is what annihilation feels like... Ah, to think I'd feel this... I've only ever deceived those who were dying...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Rather thrilling. Ah, Kaulini... What are you hiding in Amaranth Nova?
(Belial wipes blood from her lips and stands. She traces a circle with a fingertip, and a large mirror appears.)
(About to enter, she stops and looks at the moon reflected in it.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Kaulini, you're watching me here, too, aren't you?

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Enjoy this amusing moment while it lasts. I'm coming to deceive everything you are.

steps.name: What the Devil Wants
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Ariel] on 「Aether Road」, then watch all the events at the place where you followed [Ellone].
2. Once everything is over, go to the inner street of 「Linford」 and check the state of the village. Return to [Ariel] on 「Aether Road」 and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Huh? Wh-what? An earthquake?
(As Linford shakes violently before them, the startled Ariel hastily grabs Hilda's hand.)
(She struggles to rise on her little wings, but falls to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: ...We need to flee... Otherwise, like last time...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Calm down, Ariel.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I couldn't save them... I couldn't...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: That wasn't your fault.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Even so... Oh? When did the shaking stop?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It shook for a few seconds, then stopped. No sign of it starting again.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Thank goodness. But something's strange...
(Ariel flaps her wings again and rises into the air.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: What? Why did you fall earlier?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: My wings have been degenerating. Carrying someone else was too much. But over there... Amaranth Nova...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whoa, you're flying.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Well, I'm an angel. Oh, when did you arrive?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You look awful... Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: More or less. What's happening with Amaranth Nova?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: ...It seems we can approach now. Before, powerful magic forced me backward. Now it feels weaker.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As I thought...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew. Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Ariel and Hilda what happened at the River of Hatred and Oaths.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: If Ellone fell into the river of death with Belial, she must already be gone. But there's one part I find hard to believe...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Kaulini using a spirit he cherished like that... Something's wrong.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Tell us if you have an idea.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I don't know the details, but something seems different from the old Kaulini... I'm sorry. That's all I can say.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ariel, I've been wondering... How do you know Kaulini so well?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I wouldn't say well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll ask Iris to consider your circumstances when it comes to abandoning your angelic duties.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: R-really?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Oh, I blew it... No choice. I'll just tell you.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Long ago, the god I served went to judge the demon of deceit and never returned...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: The remaining spirits and angels were entrusted to various gods. I was given to Kaulini. I ran errands and came to know Ellone...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: That's when I learned the demon of deceit was Belial. She'd corrupted many gods, spirits, and living beings...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Then one day, while I was briefly away on an errand, the Beast appeared...
Crash.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: What's that sound?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Could it be...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Belial's mirror breaking...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Has she appeared again? Let's go toward the sound.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I'll watch Amaranth Nova in the meantime...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Please do. Come on, Hilda.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Right.
(The sound of breaking mirrors continues. They follow it along Aether Road, wandering until they stop at a certain point.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: No one's here. I could have sworn the sound came from nearby...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I met Ellone here before entering the River of Hatred and Oaths.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, stop.
(Deep darkness rushes in from somewhere and fills the space around them.)
(A familiar-looking figure emerges within it, rippling and flowing like a river.)
I witnessed it. I saw my companion vanish in an instant! Dead in an instant!
It intended to erase this world, including all of us here. Why won't you believe me?
What?
You say nothing on this star can be stronger than us, whom living beings call gods?
Then how do you explain the Demon Realm born from the abyss...? You refuse to admit there may be worlds we do not know.
Arrogant fools... Wake up... Together, we can defeat that monster.
We can protect our world... Create a star with power drawn from the abyss and drop it on the monster...
Why are you attacking me? I am not your enemy.
Why silence me?! Why make me human and try to kill me?!
You knew already...
To kill me... You destroyed that innocent village in the clouds...
Is this your answer? Is this truly what you want...?
Insects who will not make even the slightest effort...
You thought making me like this would end it... You never expected me to return as a Deicide...
Tell me how many more I must cut down to return. You don't know...? Sigh. I bear you no grudge, but die for me.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: For you, falling into the Demon Realm with despair, this name will suit you.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Barbatos, Grand Duke of Despair...

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I'll look forward to the day you awaken again. Until then, spend your time quietly in the Demon Realm...
(As Belial's illusion approaches, a loud sound of shattering mirrors comes from somewhere.)
Crash.
(At the sound, my eyes fly open as though struck by a great shock.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: ...It's the same as before. As though someone is deliberately showing us this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is Belial showing it to us...?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I don't think it's Belial... Could it be Daphne...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, surely not. There's no one here but us...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Don't underestimate Daphne. How can you say that after everything you've experienced? %s, what's this stuck to you? It looks like a spore...
(Hilda removes something from %s's back, and a shattering sound rings out.)
Crash.
Crash.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Where is that coming from? We wandered all over the highway without seeing any mirrors...
(Several of Belial's mirrors rise above distant Linford, then shatter all at once.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, look over there!! Mirrors are shattering where the people are!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Come on, Hilda. They're in danger!! We have to get back to the village!!
(As we return, familiar demons and beasts fly past us and crash into buildings.)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Watch out, %s!!

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Caluso, you're supposed to say that before you throw the punch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lydia? When did you get here?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Just now. Somehow, we managed to reach Linford directly without passing through Aether Road.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: We don't have time for a long explanation, so I'll keep this brief.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: While Caluso and I hold off the demons, Father Askren here will... Father? Where did he go?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Save me, senior!! The demons are chasing meeee!!

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: He needs more looking after than you'd think. I didn't expect his combat ability to be on a Priring's level... Lydia, I'll get him.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: All right, Caluso. Sorry about Father Askren... Anyway, he'll put up a barrier to protect Linford.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: He may seem hopeless, but his abilities are the real thing. You've already seen that when the Wings of Icarus was falling, remember?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: He got that enormous airship into the space on the other side.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: He's gifted at using the ancient elves' secret arts. That's why he's in demand everywhere. He says he might reach the fourth rank soon, though we'll see...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: ...Anyway, we don't know what will happen in Amaranth Nova, but the consequences could endanger Linford...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: And then the demon Belial showed up, scattered mirrors around, and vanished...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: %s, Hilda. You two go into Amaranth Nova. We'll fight the demons here and prepare for whatever happens.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You already know about me?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Oh, don't worry about that. Anyway, we're counting on you. Hurry to Amaranth Nova.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Please take care of Linford.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go, Hilda.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Lydia, send Roro over here!

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Roro, go put some power into Caluso's fists.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Phew, you saved me. Just two more places to check now.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Well done, Father Askren. The demons are scared, so run while you have the chance!

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Yes, senior!

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Caluso, all the villagers have been evacuated. Luckily, it looks like no one's hurt.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Lydia, about the people here...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: I know what you're going to say. But right now Father Askren needs to concentrate, and we have to help see the oracle through.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: A place where the holy and the wicked intersect, within a fragment of the Celestial Realm... What is this place...?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: It... it hurts... These memories...

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Father Askren, stay with us!! Don't let yourself feel the emotions of the memories entering your mind!!

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Roro, draw out the rage inside me... I need to end this in one stroke...

steps.name: A Time of Despair
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Ariel] on 「Aether Road」, then enter 「Amaranth Nova」.
2. Defeat [Demon God Kaulini] in 「Amaranth Nova」. Leave through the reward room, then turn in the quest to [Ariel] on 「Aether Road」.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: G-go away. D-don't follow me.
(Ariel flees a beast, then trips and falls.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: An angel like me wouldn't even taste good...
(Thud!)
(The beast is sent flying into the distance.)

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Are you all right, Ariel?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Th-thank you, Hailey... I'll be going, then...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Where are you going, little angel?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: H-how did you know?

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: I can see those beautiful wings you had back then...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: It looks like whatever was blocking that place is gone... Am I right?
(As Hailey approaches Amaranth Nova, Ariel pulls her back.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: You can't. An ordinary human or elf could be annihilated just by approaching it.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Even a high elf who's lived centuries longer than other elves?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Even you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hailey. You were here? Ariel, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I'm fine. Hailey helped me.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: That's good. But Hailey, what are you doing? Have you found out everything?
(Hailey curiously touches Ariel's little wings.)

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Oh! Sorry. They looked so soft, I reached out without thinking.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: It's all right. I suppose I can't hide them anymore...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Now that Amaranth Nova is accessible, I think its holy power is affecting me.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Oh, is the village all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Demigods and priests from the Order are fighting the beasts and demons. It looks like the villagers have already evacuated...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: ...It's a relief that the Order's Demigods and priests are here... Tell me the name of the demon who owns those mirrors.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Belial.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hailey, please help Ariel take care of the beasts here. We have something to do in there.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: We? Oh, all right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And Ariel, thank you for helping. I didn't mean it when I said I'd tell Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: ...No, it's all right. Um... Once you enter Amaranth Nova, you won't be able to leave until this is resolved.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: It won't be an easy path, but please come back safely...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll remember that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go, Hilda.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: All right...
(As Hilda and I run toward Amaranth Nova, demons and beasts swarm out of the highway as though they have been waiting.)

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Ariel, can you use healing magic or anything like that?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: It isn't magic, but I can do something similar.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Good. Then... use it when I ask. I'm going to clear away everything in front of us.
(The star's fall from the abyss left a hole in the city. Hilda and I run carefully, taking care not to fall.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's far worse than it looked from a distance... And what is this suffocating presence?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It's the power of the Celestial Realm, something we couldn't properly sense in its fragment. Now it really feels like we're in the domain of a god.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, I was mistaken.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hm?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: This is... his presence. %s, get back. Now!
(A black butterfly flies in and spreads into the silhouette of a man.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I've been waiting, %s. Today may be the last time anyone calls me by that name.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Hilda is here too. I was hoping you would come alone, %s... How disappointing.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Ha ha. It doesn't matter either way, then. Very well. Now that you've met me, neither of you is likely to leave alive.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You look different from before.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Is that a compliment? Never mind. I had hoped the goddess and the adventurer would come here together. A pity.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Those eyes, full of contempt. I like them. Then let me bring this to an end.
(Barbatos raises his sword, but blood begins to flow from his mouth and eyes.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: ...It can't be...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: ...This cannot be...
(He wipes away the blood, but bloody tears continue to flow as his wounds widen.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something's wrong...)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I gathered all this power to become a god again. Why...? Cough, cough...
(He wraps himself in his cloak, turns, and runs.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos, stop!!

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Cough, cough... %s... Shall we postpone our long-awaited moment? It wouldn't be enjoyable with me like this...
(Barbatos leaps into the black hole at the center of Amaranth Nova.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Wh-what?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Something seems to have happened to Barbatos...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's follow him. But how do we get down there? Do we just jump...?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Stop, %s. You can't jump straight down from here. You'd be annihilated instantly. Watch.
(Hilda throws a stone, and it instantly turns to dust.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Don't forget we're in a god's domain. We have to move carefully...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Hilda... But what's down there?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: We'll find out when we get there...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Hah, hah... There...
(We descend into the black hole through surging magical power and find a ruined temple. After wandering through it, we spot a dark figure.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's Barbatos, Hilda. Hilda? Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine...
(Sensing us, Barbatos wipes away his blood and approaches.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You've finally arrived.
(The Grand Duke of Despair, darker than before and far from the image of a holy god, sneers at us.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I've been waiting. As it turns out, I will be welcoming you here. It isn't the situation I wanted...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: ...But it will not prevent me from claiming your souls. Before we begin, there is something I must tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you going to tell us?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: ...An insignificant old tale.
(He closes his eyes, and a barrier of magical power rises. Beyond a pillar, a statue shaped like a person comes into view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I... I can barely breathe... What is that...?)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Long ago, in the distant past, there was only one means of defeating the monster that sought to devour the gods and all life.
(Scenes of the ancient past flow beyond the magical barrier.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: ...The one who is now the God of the Astral Realm may have defeated that monster as a human, but at the time, it was our only means.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The gods of that time did not fight. Only a select few shared a certain 'secret'...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The secret was that the Absolute would destroy this planet. Perhaps he is the old man you know.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Those who had created this world and claimed to love life were preparing to flee to another world, without protecting the lives here...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Part of that process was hidden behind the name 'Twilight.'

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Lethe was exiled, and Hecate was imprisoned in an eternity of time... You know the rest...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I can only pity the gods who died knowing nothing...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: They tried to make me human and kill me too, but they overlooked one fact. I, too, was born a god.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: In any case, the pain brought on by Belial tampering with my memories reminded me of the star that fell into the abyss with me, and I came here.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Because their grave lay here, beneath Linford...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I seem to remember regretting my failure to protect precious lives, and vowing never to lose them again...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Why can I no longer recall that feeling...?
(He closes his eyes, and a powerful vortex of magical energy rises.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Th-this is on a completely different level from any power I've felt before. What... It's almost like...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's like Demiurgos... No, even greater... Hm?)
(Barbatos opens his eyes, concentrates his power in his gunblade, and fires in one direction.)
Crash.
Aaaaaagh—!!
(A mirror shatters with a scream.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: A mere demon dares to interfere with this moment...
(He looks satisfied, then turns his gaze to Hilda.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Hilda, you're prepared to wound yourself. But why not step back for now?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: This moment belongs to %s and me... If you spill blood here, Ouroboros will appear and ruin everything.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It would do nothing to help the current goddess, either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, stand back. I'll handle this. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Don't worry...
(Hilda lowers her head and steps back. Barbatos's expression twists.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Seeing you like this disgusts me. Does it not matter what happens to you?!

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Even if you become a Deicide for someone else? Even if you lose yourself for the goddess?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My answer hasn't changed since then. I've already made my choice, so don't ask me again.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I once faced the world with feelings like yours. But despair dragged me into the mire of the abyss...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Now I will show you the end, adventurer of the goddess...
(A gold coin appears and lands in his hand.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The power of those who tried to kill me has become mine...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I will kill the feeble goddess you love and seal her in this coffin with the other gods...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I will become the master of every soul and everything those souls love, and rule this world.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Even if I am a demon god, unworthy of holiness...
(The coin leaps up and stops in midair.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: If there is something you wish to protect, if you wish to move forward, cast aside your fear and kill me.
(%s's face is reflected in the coin as he pulls the gunblade's trigger.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: 「Mortal, from this moment, your time is 'despair.'」

lines.speaker: 마신 카울리니
lines.text: You could not endure...
(Demon God Kaulini fires bullets at %s, who groans in pain.)

lines.speaker: 마신 카울리니
lines.text: You could not bear it...
(Red liquid falls where the greatsword has passed.)
(He aims his gun at the blood-covered adventurer struggling to move.)

lines.speaker: 마신 카울리니
lines.text: I acknowledge that my time with you was as magnificent as I had hoped. You simply fell short of me.
(Thud.)
(Kaulini smiles at the fallen adventurer's unfocused eyes.)

lines.speaker: 마신 카울리니
lines.text: For the sake of the gods who cherished you, I will grant you a special place in there. Dream of the abyss alongside them.
(He lifts the adventurer toward the coffin holding the gods' remains, then notices Hilda.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Kaulini.

lines.speaker: 마신 카울리니
lines.text: You dare speak a god's name so carelessly. But I will forgive you this once. Hilda, return to your own time and savor this moment.

lines.speaker: 마신 카울리니
lines.text: Now that the adventurer is dead, your soul can exist whole again. If you wish, I can send you back to your own time.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Telling me to return to a world about to be destroyed? How cruel...
(Hilda smiles and pricks her index finger with a dagger. Blood flows onto the floor and quickly seeps toward Kaulini and %s.)
(Kaulini tries to stop the blood, but it merges with Amaranth Nova's magical power and continues to flow.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Kaulini, sending me back to my original worldline from the start so I couldn't interfere... Well done. How fitting for a god.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I am a witch with cursed power. By wounding myself, I can use the powers of healing and regeneration in reverse...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It's fortunate the demon god paid me no mind...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: The world I'm in will soon disappear... If it's going to vanish anyway, perhaps this is better than being swallowed by Ouroboros.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'll give you my soul.
(A blinding light fills the space, followed by a huge explosion.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Gah! Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened...? Barbatos definitely...
(I look around and see Barbatos smiling, his weapon in his hand.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I hoped it wouldn't turn into the worst possible situation, like when I was dragged into the river...
(Barbatos bites his lip, takes a gold coin from inside his clothes, and flips it above his gunblade.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos!!
(Our weapons clash with a deafening sound that fills the space. A moment's hesitation sends one of them flying upward.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Now.)
(Seizing the opening, %s strikes.)
(Thud.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: %s, to return alive and humiliate me like this...
(Barbatos lies fallen, coughing blood, and gives %s a twisted smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos. No, Kaulini. You were once a god who loved life, but now you're only a demon trying to defile the world...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You must have felt wronged. But this isn't the place to unleash that rage...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: ...Cough, cough... Is that so?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Then where am I supposed to pour out these feelings?! Cough, cough.
(Barbatos touches the fragment of gunblade embedded in his chest.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Then teach me. Show me how someone like me can face the world again...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos, you've already spent far too long as a demon in the Demon Realm.
(At that moment, the adventurer catches a sharp gold coin flying overhead.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A coin with the same demon-horn emblem engraved on both sides... Then the outcome was decided from the start.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Heh... You caught me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's over, Barbatos.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: ...Don't think...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: ...that this...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: ...is the end...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, are you awake?
(Iris holds both of the adventurer's hands, looking on with concern.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...? Is it really you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How are you here, Iris? And where are we...?
(Iris gently embraces the confused adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: We're inside Amaranth Nova, where you were fighting just a moment ago. And the oracle I gave you is fulfilled.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...It's over... Phew...
(Only now does the tension leave the adventurer, who lets out a soft sigh of relief.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry for placing such a heavy burden on you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I will move this space into the Great Wall, so nothing can emerge from it.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Then the time created by Kaulini will be set right as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Linford too?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The wall around Linford is gone. The residents can come and go freely.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The souls of the residents who fell victim to Kaulini and then awakened again have returned to how they were.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: But because they've already been wounded once, a similar experience could shatter them at any moment.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Their memories haven't vanished. They will keep the time they've lived through and go on living as before.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I will be here to keep them from falling apart, so don't worry too much...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right... Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Do you still have that item?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Which item?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The one Lady Medea gave you in the Kali village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, this. She said it would help stop Daphne...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Do you remember Hilda?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who? Hilda?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hilda...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: She helped make it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, really? I'll have to thank her when I meet her.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Shall we go?
(With a lonely look in her eyes, Iris forms the bow of light, Celestia, at her fingertips. A beam from the sky circles its tip, becoming a beautiful arrow of light.)
(The sharply condensed arrow flies forward, creating an enormous gate of light.)

steps.name: Clouds Half Dispersed
steps.objective: Talk to [Ariel] on 「Aether Road」, then go past the angel statue in 「Linford」 and find [Elliot]. Once all conversations are over, return to [Elliot] in 「Linford」 and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: ...Huh?
(Ariel lowers the hands she had been waving to keep a beast from biting her wings and looks around.)
(Meeting her eyes, Hailey strikes the beast at her feet with her staff, then looks toward Amaranth Nova.)

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: The demons and beasts that attacked are disappearing... Get up, Ariel.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Thank you. Hm?
(A circle of light forms in the distance, and two people step out.)

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: It looks like they finished things safely.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Amaranth Nova still feels the same... Um, who's that with %s...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ariel, Hailey, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hello, Hailey. Hello, Ariel.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: We're fine. Is everything inside settled? And this is...?
(When Hailey meets Iris's eyes, she steps back in surprise and bows her head.)

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: ...It is an honor to meet you.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Excuse me, but who are you? You must be someone extraordinary to come out of there with %s...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Read the room, little angel.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ariel, this is Iris...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: It's nice to meet you, Lady... Iris? Oh!

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Aaaaaah, forgive me, my goddess. I'm sorry. When I ran away back then...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's all right, Ariel. That's all in the past.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Then y-you forgive me?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Just do your best from now on.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Oh, then that settles it. From now on...?

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Is everything in Linford resolved now...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, it's all right to tell these two, isn't it?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly explain to Hailey and Ariel how everything was resolved.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: What a relief...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Neither of you needs to feel guilty anymore. I will make sure no star falls again, spilling wounds and tears.
(Relieved smiles spread across Hailey's and Ariel's faces.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Please keep looking after Linford, as you always have. Hailey, continue striking down the demons that threaten the world...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Understood...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And Ariel, as Linford's guardian angel, watch over the entrance to Amaranth Nova and keep anything dangerous from happening.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Why do you look so surprised? You've had plenty of rest.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: That's true, but...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Live as you normally would, and watch over their souls so they do not crumble.
(Iris smiles brightly and strokes Ariel's wings.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Then someday, you'll be able to regain your original wings.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: My wings, just as they were...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Yes, I'll do my best!

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: But %s, didn't you come with someone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came with Elliot, one of Linford's residents.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, Iris, is it all right to stay away from the Oracle Chamber this long?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I haven't left it... How should I explain this...?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I can now separate and control my divine and human aspects to some extent.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: While I watch over the Great Wall as a 'god' in the Oracle Chamber, I can move around as 'Iris.'

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Though I can't keep it up for very long...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Wow, that's amazing! No one's ever been like you, Lady Iris...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Some created incarnations like Lady Gaia, or became human and lived among them like Lord Agni.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: You're incredible, Lady Iris!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: ...I didn't expect to be praised for this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah ha ha...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So she can move freely now... That means her responsibilities will grow too...)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, I'm sorry. I'm not used to being like this yet, so I think I need to return and rest.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: We need to find Daphne between the Great Walls soon... I'll call you shortly.
(Iris brings her hands together, and a circle of light forms before her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll be waiting.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Goodbye, both of you.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: We'll see you again.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Goodbye, Lady Iris.
(After receiving everyone's farewells, Iris steps into the circle, through which the Oracle Chamber is visible.)
(When Iris vanishes with the circle of light, Ariel relaxes and sinks to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Phewww...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right, Ariel?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I'm fine...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll head into the village now. What will you two do?

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: To meet the actual God of the Astral Realm in person...

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Oh, there's work to do, so I think I should talk to Ariel.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Hailey, me?

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: We have to, Ariel. It's Lady Iris's command...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Hmm. My past is forgiven, but now I have to keep working... (Mutter, mutter.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha ha. See you later, then.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: See you, %s...

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: %s walks so fast. Gone before we'd even finished speaking. But Hailey, what's behind you...?

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: What is it now? Aaaaaagh!! A giant Priring!

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: You startled me. Ring.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Juriring?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Ariel, it's good to see you. It's been a long time. Ring. Juriring is here. Ring.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Has it been ten years? No, a hundred? What brings you here?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm here to cheer you on. Ring.
(As %s enters the residential district and looks around, someone gently tugs at their clothes.)

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: Um...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Char, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: I'm fine. At some point, the bad things disappeared...

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: And I don't think I can see strange things anymore...

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: I won't ask what happened. I'll just believe it's thanks to the priests who fought so hard over there.

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Char...
(Perhaps having seen Charlotte say goodbye to %s and head home, Elliot runs over from a distance, on the verge of tears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: My father, my father...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened to Benjamin?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I-I think his memories have c-completely returned!! Kiril is fine too!! So is everyone else!!

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Waaah...!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's wonderful. Elliot, you can stop crying.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Hehe, all right...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Does that mean your work in Linford is finished, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. That's why I'm looking around the village now.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: It still feels like I left Linford three years ago, but I'm going to stop worrying about it... Whether it's been three years or ten, I'm happy to be home...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: If I get the chance, I'd like to visit Dorothy Village and thank Glinda, Binah, and Mr. Runo.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I happen to stop by Dorothy Village, I'll pass on your regards.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Thank you, %s. And...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Oh, there was... someone else, I think... Who was it? Not the Elusive Boss or the Munchkin tribe...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: You're not planning to leave right away, are you?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: My father wants to repay the priests who worked so hard for the village. So... please come to our house...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I'll be waiting.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: ...It's all right if you don't, but I'd be a little disappointed...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I-I'll come. Please don't cry.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Thank you, %s...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I'll go buy a few things at Kiril's shop. See you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Elliot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I've seen all of Linford... There doesn't seem to be any danger left...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then shall I head to Benjamin's house...?

lines.speaker: 벤자민
lines.text: Once again, on behalf of the villagers, thank you. We are truly grateful that you protected our home.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Please, we only did what we had to.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Thank you for this magnificent hospitality. All thanks belong to the goddess.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Benjamin, this is so delicious I could die eating it and never notice. I'm looking forward to our stay in Linford.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Father Askren, we're leaving early tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: What? We're in Linford, the City of Angels! There's so much to see, and we're leaving already?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: We have 'more' work to do.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: ...I'll stay here. You two go ahead.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: It's something only you can do, Father Askren. It will please the goddess, too.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: If it's for the goddess, then I must step forward.

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: He's an easy elf to handle. I thought they were all serious like Hailey...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah ha ha ha...

lines.speaker: 벤자민
lines.text: This is what Linford used to be like. To think we can come and go freely again, just as we did then... I'm so excited.

lines.speaker: 벤자민
lines.text: My son and I have much to discuss, so I'll take my leave. Thank you all for your time.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Thank you, everyone.

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: I have to tidy up the shop, so I'll be going too. Goodbye, everyone.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: They've all gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll head in and rest too. Get some rest, everyone. Thank you for your hard work.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Wait a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: ...It seems you still haven't realized...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: It's nothing. More importantly, I'd like you to come with us. There's somewhere Daphne might go.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Lady Iris should now be able to sense roughly where people are. If there's a place even she can't find...

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Don't tell me...
(Askren drops the bread from his mouth and stares at Lydia.)

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Are we going to the Demon Realm?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: No. The elf village.
